text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: Chain scission gives one carboxyl and one hydroxyl end. The

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: carboxyl end lowers the local pH and accelerates further

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: hydrolysis (autocatalysis), so thick parts degrade from the

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: inside out — bulk erosion rather than surface erosion.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: Enzymes are large and hydrolyse only segments they can reach,

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: so scission is confined to accessible disordered regions.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: Crystallinity sets the rate: the same order that provides

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: strength and moisture resistance also blocks degradation.

g.text: Ordering only; no calculated values are implied. Quantitative barriers for the three regimes, and for the autocatalytic route in (a),

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: are obtained from DFT with an implicit solvation model.
